rules.description: Executable has CAP_SETUID or CAP_SETGID, providing direct control over process UID or GID credentials.
rules.exploit: Execute the capable binary and abuse its UID or GID manipulation capability to obtain higher-privileged process credentials.

rules.description: Executable has filesystem permission or ownership capabilities that can bypass normal discretionary access controls.
rules.exploit: Abuse the capable executable to access, modify, or change ownership of files normally protected from the current user, then use the resulting access to cross a privilege boundary.
